t: You are looking at the Church of St Andrew, a Church of England church on Holborn, on the northwestern edge of the City of London. Christopher Wren designed it. He was given the job of rebuilding 52 City churches after the Great Fire of 1666, St Paul's Cathedral among them. Several notable people are buried here. John Gerard kept a large garden in Holborn, and his illustrated Herball of 1597 became a popular gardening book. Thomas Coram, the sea captain who created the Foundling Hospital for abandoned children, is also buried here. So are the composer and organist John Stanley and the mathematicians John Craig and Edmund Wingate.
